# Hash-pinned pip used to bootstrap CI jobs.
#
# The runner's preinstalled pip may still trust the withdrawn emSign root CA,
# so the upgrade itself is protected by a hash check rather than by TLS alone.
# Dependabot keeps the version and hash current (see .github/dependabot.yml).
# Install with:
#   python -m pip install --no-cache-dir --require-hashes -r .github/requirements-pip-bootstrap.txt
pip==26.2.2 \
    --hash=sha256:fd7f4dfa8190e014013b9f08f3e973f4e4c26ffd179a204895533a7254813a70
